chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) sent me to Medina and said: 'Do not leave any image except that you erase it, nor any grave except that you level it, nor any dog except that you kill it.'

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful, a title for Imam Ali (peace be upon him).
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: Messenger of Allah, referring to Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family).
key_terms.صُورَةً: Image or picture, often referring to depictions of living beings which were discouraged or erased.
key_terms.قَبْراً: Grave, referring to the act of leveling or flattening them.
key_terms.كَلْباً: Dog, referring to the specific command to kill them in this context.

ai.seo_question: What were the three specific commands given by the Prophet to Imam Ali when he was sent to Medina?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi records the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) instructing Imam Ali (peace be upon him) to purify Medina by erasing images, leveling uneven graves, and killing dogs, reflecting the early Islamic effort to eradicate pre-Islamic (Jahiliyyah) practices of idolatry and impurity. While 'images' (suwar) generally refer to statues or depictions of animate beings that could lead to shirk, the command to 'level' graves addresses the removal of mounds that might be venerated, and 'killing dogs' specifically targets the stray or unclean dogs prevalent in the city at that time. This incident underscores the Shia scholarly view of Imam Ali as the active executor of the Prophet's directives in consolidating religious purity in the heart of Medina.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> sent me<sup>asws</sup> to Al-Medina, so he<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Neither leave any picture except delete it, nor any grave except even it, nor a dog except kill it’.
en.sarwar: 14. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Nawfaliy from al-Sakuniy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has stated this Hadith. ‘

’Amir al-Mu’minin has said, ‘Once the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, sent me to al-Madinah saying, “Do not leave any picture without being deleted, any graves without being leveled and any dog without being put to sleep.’””
